subject: Mar 26th, 2026
fact: The events of the chapter occur on Mar 26th, 2026.
source_quote: Date: Mar 26th, 2026

subject: Alrrem
fact: Alrrem is the deity proclaimed by the Fire Temple warlock as the source of the Chimera's power.
source_quote: proclaiming it the champion of Alrrem, the all-consuming

subject: Sequioa
fact: Sequioa is knocked unconscious by the Chimera's combined fury and magical blasts.
source_quote: Sequioa charges the beast but is quickly knocked unconscious by its combined fury and the warlock's magical blasts

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr slips past the Chimera and rips the control chain from the warlock's hands.
source_quote: Zephyr slips past the rampaging monster and rips the control chain from the warlock's hands

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer uses divine power to mend Sequioa's wounds and bring him back to his feet.
source_quote: Calmer uses divine power to mend Sequioa's wounds and bring him back to his feet

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer ends the battle by invoking a necrotic tolling resonance that drops the Chimera dead on the cold stone floor.
source_quote: Calmer ends the battle by invoking a necrotic tolling resonance that drops the Chimera dead on the cold stone floor

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia delivers a series of precise strikes to the warlock, eventually killing him.
source_quote: Zinnia delivers a series of precise strikes to the warlock, eventually killing him

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia rushes Romag with a flurry of precise, devastating strikes during the assassination.
source_quote: Zinnia rushed him with a flurry of precise, devastating strikes

subject: Romag
fact: Romag is the High Priest of the Earth Temple who orders the party to strike the weakened Fire Temple.
source_quote: brought their findings to Romag, the High Priest of the Earth Temple, who received the news with thunderous fury and ordered them to strike the weakened Fire Temple

subject: Romag
fact: Romag lectures Hartsch on the slow, erosive power of dust.
source_quote: Sequioa could hear Romag lecturing Hartsch on the slow, erosive power of dust

subject: Hartsch
fact: Hartsch is Romag's sub-general who reveals the political landscape and hints at his ambition for leadership.
source_quote: a private meeting with Hartsch, Romag's sub-general, that proved far more illuminating. Hartsch laid out the political landscape in stark detail

subject: Hartsch
fact: Hartsch places his weapons on the ground and steps aside when he recognizes the assassination is occurring.
source_quote: Hartsch, instantly understanding what was happening, placed his weapons on the ground and stepped aside

subject: Hartsch
fact: Hartsch plunges his hands into Romag's body and covers them in blood.
source_quote: Hartsch plunged his hands into Romag's body, covered them in blood

subject: Hartsch
fact: Hartsch declares himself Supreme Prophet of the Earth Temple.
source_quote: He declared himself Supreme Prophet

subject: Hartsch
fact: Hartsch introduces the party to his troops as the Obsidian Edge.
source_quote: Hartsch introduced the party to his troops as the Obsidian Edge

subject: Hartsch
fact: Hartsch orders a full-scale charge after learning the Fire Temple is attacking the Water Temple.
source_quote: Hartsch erupted with triumphant fury and ordered a full-scale charge

subject: Dren
fact: Dren is the leader of the Crimson Guard who arranges a morning meeting with Romag.
source_quote: They enlisted Dren, the leader of the Crimson Guard, to arrange a morning meeting with Romag

subject: Dren
fact: Dren is visibly impressed by the party's victory over the Chimera.
source_quote: Dren, visibly impressed by the party's victory over the Chimera, agreed without hesitation

subject: Dren
fact: Dren prepares his men for battle and is sent into the fray by the party.
source_quote: They encountered Dren preparing his men for battle, and after a brief exchange, sent him and his Crimson Guard into the fray

subject: Captain Vesrek
fact: Captain Vesrek of the Crimson Traitor sold the Chimera to the Fire Temple.
source_quote: a bill of sale from Captain Vesrek of the Crimson Traitor

subject: Belsornig
fact: Belsornig is the prophet of the Water Temple who orchestrated the Chimera attack.
source_quote: the name Belsornig appeared in the document, an ally of the Water Temple, suggesting that the Water Temple's prophet had orchestrated the entire affair

subject: Belsornig
fact: Belsornig is named by Alrrem in rage after the party reveals his betrayal.
source_quote: Alrrem's enraged voice screamed Belsornig's name

subject: Kelno
fact: Kelno is the leader of the Air Temple who believes the wraith is an air elemental.
source_quote: Calmer... noted with grim amusement that the Air Temple's leader Kelno was so ignorant he apparently believed the wraith to be an air elemental

subject: Fire Temple
fact: The Fire Temple purchased the Chimera and used it to attack the party.
source_quote: a wax-sealed ledger bore the crest of a crimson ship — a bill of sale from Captain Vesrek of the Crimson Traitor — detailing the purchase of the Chimera by the Fire Temple

subject: Water Temple
fact: The Water Temple's prophet, Belsornig, orchestrated the Chimera attack to eliminate the party or bankrupt the Fire Temple.
source_quote: the name Belsornig appeared in the document, an ally of the Water Temple, suggesting that the Water Temple's prophet had orchestrated the entire affair as a calculated win-win

subject: Earth Temple
fact: The Earth Temple is led by Romag until his assassination, after which Hartsch becomes its new leader.
source_quote: Romag, the High Priest of the Earth Temple... Hartsch declared himself Supreme Prophet

subject: Air Temple
fact: The Air Temple is described as a powerless remnant and its leader believes a wraith is an air elemental.
source_quote: the Air Temple was a powerless remnant... Kelno was so ignorant he apparently believed the wraith to be an air elemental

subject: Crimson Guard
fact: The Crimson Guard is led by Dren and is enlisted to arrange a meeting with Romag.
source_quote: They enlisted Dren, the leader of the Crimson Guard, to arrange a morning meeting with Romag

subject: Nulb's river pirates
fact: Nulb's river pirates stamped the iron chains used to control the Chimera.
source_quote: heavy iron chains stamped with the marks of Nulb's river pirates

subject: Chimera
fact: A Chimera with the hindquarters of a goat, the forequarters of a lion, and the wings of a dragon was unleashed by the Fire Temple warlock.
source_quote: A Fire Temple warlock unleashed a Chimera—a beast with the hindquarters of a goat, the forequarters of a lion, and the wings of a dragon

subject: Chimera
fact: The Chimera knocked Sequioa and Zephyr unconscious before being killed by Calmer's necrotic resonance.
source_quote: The beast had ravaged the party, battering Sequioa and Zephyr into unconsciousness before Calmer's divine gifts pulled them back from the brink of death... dropped the Chimera dead

subject: wraith
fact: A wraith haunts the halls of the Air Temple and drifts toward the party as they pass through.
source_quote: they knew a wraith haunted its halls, and sure enough, the spectral guardian began drifting toward them

subject: Romag's sleeping chamber
fact: Romag's sleeping chamber is decorated with earthen motifs, has a dirt-covered floor, a small altar in the corner, and a desk scattered with personal notes.
source_quote: emerging into Romag's sleeping chamber — a room decorated with earthen motifs, its floor covered in dirt, a small altar in the corner and a desk scattered with personal notes

subject: Fire Temple entrance
fact: The entrance to the Fire Temple has massive brass doors covered in leering faces and horrible scenes.
source_quote: passing through a magically lit corridor pulsing with gray, green, and red light, its massive brass doors covered in leering faces and horrible scenes. At the entrance to the Fire Temple

subject: Air Temple
fact: The Air Temple is eerily quiet and its corridors are dimly lit.
source_quote: a section of the dungeon that was eerily, unsettlingly quiet... moved through the dim corridors

subject: second level of the dungeon
fact: The second level of the dungeon is flooded with water and choked with zones of scalding steam during the battle.
source_quote: emerging onto the second level, the party found a chaotic battlefield flooded with water and choked with zones of scalding steam

subject: wax-sealed ledger
fact: The wax-sealed ledger bears the crest of a crimson ship and details the purchase of the Chimera by the Fire Temple.
source_quote: A wax-sealed ledger bore the crest of a crimson ship — a bill of sale from Captain Vesrek of the Crimson Traitor — detailing the purchase of the Chimera by the Fire Temple

subject: heavy gold amulet
fact: The warlock carried a heavy gold amulet bearing the eight-pointed symbol of the Fire Temple.
source_quote: a heavy gold amulet bearing the eight-pointed symbol of the Fire Temple

subject: potion of fire resistance
fact: The warlock carried a potion of fire resistance that he never managed to reach for.
source_quote: a potion of fire resistance he had never managed to reach for

subject: masterwork whip
fact: The warlock carried a masterwork whip made of alchemically treated red leather.
source_quote: a masterwork whip of alchemically treated red leather

subject: iron chains
fact: The iron chains used to control the Chimera are stamped with the marks of Nulb's river pirates.
source_quote: heavy iron chains stamped with the marks of Nulb's river pirates

subject: Sacred vestments
fact: Hartsch holds Romag's sacred vestments aloft when declaring himself Supreme Prophet.
source_quote: holding Romag's sacred vestments aloft

subject: note
fact: The party slips a note under the Fire Temple door claiming to have information about a betrayal.
source_quote: Zephyr slipped a note under the door claiming to have information about a betrayal

subject: Chimera's attack
fact: The Fire Temple warlock unleashes a Chimera upon the party.
source_quote: A Fire Temple warlock unleashed a Chimera—a beast with the hindquarters of a goat, the forequarters of a lion, and the wings of a dragon—proclaiming it the champion of Alrrem sent to destroy the party

subject: Chimera kills warlock
fact: The Chimera turns its fire breath upon its former master and a nearby bugbear.
source_quote: causing the Chimera to turn its fire breath upon its former master and a nearby bugbear

subject: Chimera's death
fact: Calmer's necrotic resonance drops the Chimera dead on the cold stone floor.
source_quote: Calmer ends the battle by invoking a necrotic tolling resonance that drops the Chimera dead on the cold stone floor

subject: discovery of ledger
fact: The party uncovers a wax-sealed ledger linking the Chimera's purchase to Captain Vesrek and revealing Belsornig's involvement.
source_quote: The party looted the warlock's charred remains, finding a wax-sealed ledger linking the Chimera's purchase to Captain Vesrek of the Crimson Traitor and revealing the Water Temple's prophet Belsornig as the orchestrator

subject: Romag orders attack on Fire Temple
fact: Romag orders the party to strike the weakened Fire Temple after reviewing the evidence.
source_quote: brought their findings to Romag... who received the news with thunderous fury and ordered them to strike the weakened Fire Temple

subject: Hartsch reveals ambition
fact: Hartsch makes clear he would consider himself worthy of leadership if a position were to open.
source_quote: Hartsch made no effort to hide his ambitions — if a position of leadership were to suddenly open itself, he would absolutely consider himself worthy of it

subject: plan to assassinate Romag
fact: The party formulates a plan to assassinate Romag and install Hartsch as the new Earth Temple leader.
source_quote: The party formulates a bold plan: assassinate Romag, install Hartsch as the Earth Temple's new leader, and engineer a three-way war between the Earth, Fire, and Water Temples to destroy all three factions from within

subject: Dren arranges meeting
fact: Dren agrees to arrange a morning meeting with Romag to ensure the high priest is off-guard.
source_quote: Dren, visibly impressed by the party's victory over the Chimera, agreed without hesitation and returned with confirmation that Romag was looking forward to the meeting

subject: sealing Romag's chamber
fact: Zephyr uses magic to slam the doors of Romag's chamber shut, isolating him from guards.
source_quote: Zephyr invoked a subtle but powerful magic, causing the doors of Romag's chamber to slam shut with a resonant bang

subject: assassination of Romag
fact: Zinnia and Sequioa strike Romag while Calmer channels necrotic power, killing him.
source_quote: Zinnia rushed him with a flurry of precise, devastating strikes, followed by Sequioa landing blow after blow on the stunned high priest. Calmer... channeled a wave of necrotic power that caused Romag to wither and collapse dead

subject: Hartsch declares himself Supreme Prophet
fact: Hartsch marches into the main chamber holding Romag's vestments and declares himself Supreme Prophet.
source_quote: Hartsch... marched into the main chamber of the Earth Temple, holding Romag's sacred vestments aloft. He declared himself Supreme Prophet

subject: introduction of Obsidian Edge
fact: Hartsch introduces the party as his personal vanguard, the Obsidian Edge.
source_quote: Hartsch introduced the party to his troops as the Obsidian Edge

subject: note delivered to Fire Temple
fact: The party slips a note under the Fire Temple door claiming to have information about a betrayal.
source_quote: Zephyr slipped a note under the door claiming to have information about a betrayal

subject: Alrrem orders attack on Water Temple
fact: Alrrem, enraged by the revelation of Belsornig's betrayal, orders his troops to attack the Water Temple immediately.
source_quote: Alrrem's enraged voice screamed Belsornig's name and ordered his troops to attack the Water Temple immediately

subject: barricade erected
fact: Fire Temple bugbears drag heavy wooden pews and stone rubble across the stairway to the second level, creating a barricade.
source_quote: Fire Temple bugbears had dragged heavy wooden pews and stone rubble across the stairway to the second level, creating a makeshift barricade

subject: party bypasses barricade via Air Temple
fact: The party bypasses the barricade by cutting through the Air Temple.
source_quote: The party chose to bypass the barricade entirely by cutting through the Air Temple

subject: wraith encounters party
fact: The wraith in the Air Temple drifts toward the party but turns back when they flee.
source_quote: the spectral guardian began drifting toward them as they moved through the dim corridors. Rather than engage it, the party ran, and the wraith... turned back into the darkness

subject: battle begins on second level
fact: Zinnia rushes the lead Fire Temple warrior through the mist with dagger strikes, beginning the battle for the second level.
source_quote: Zinnia moved first, rushing the lead Fire Temple warrior through the mist with a pair of precise dagger strikes — and the battle for the second level had begun in earnest

subject: Hartsch orders full-scale charge
fact: Hartsch orders a full-scale charge after learning the Fire Temple is attacking the Water Temple.
source_quote: Hartsch erupted with triumphant fury and ordered a full-scale charge

subject: party sends Crimson Guard into fray
fact: The party sends Dren and his Crimson Guard into the battle.
source_quote: sent him and his Crimson Guard into the fray

subject: Calmer nearly invokes Saint Cuthbert
fact: Calmer nearly invokes the name of his holy patron mid-assassination before catching himself.
source_quote: Calmer, nearly invoking the name of his holy patron before catching himself in the most spectacularly ill-timed moment imaginable

subject: destructive power of earth
fact: Hartsch declares that the power of Earth is destructive, not erosive.
source_quote: the era of passive resignation was over and that the destructive power of earth would now be unleashed upon their enemies

subject: Obsidian Edge
fact: The party is publicly hailed as the Obsidian Edge, Hartsch's personal vanguard.
source_quote: Hartsch introduced the party to his troops as the Obsidian Edge — his personal vanguard, the sharpest stone in the deep earth, cutting through fire and water from the shadows before anyone felt the quake

subject: three-way war
fact: The party engineers a three-way war between the Earth, Fire, and Water Temples to destroy all three factions from within.
source_quote: engineer a three-way war between the Earth, Fire, and Water Temples to destroy all three factions from within
